summary: Iteration 4 fully tested — backend 17/17 pytest passing, frontend flows verified. Amp source→input map, SmartThings config + set_input + set_volume, tv volume slider, commissioning guide, and power-on retry all work as specified. Regressions (matrix routing/broadcast, climate, camera, automations) still green.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is nearing ~700 lines; consider splitting device routes into routers/*.py in a future iteration.

TVDriver.power live path uses time.sleep in blocking retry (up to 4×2s=8s) inside an async endpoint call chain — fine in demo (skipped), but under live conditions this could block the FastAPI event loop worker. Consider running via asyncio.to_thread or using async httpx.
SmartThingsDriver._cmd retry sleeps 1.5s × 3 (~4.5s worst-case) in-thread; same event-loop blocking concern for live path.
display_tvvolume always logs SmartThings entry (simulated when not ready) which is fine, but slightly noisy — an option to skip logging when not ready could reduce log churn.
seed_data_creation: None — used /api/state/reset and cleaned up config to demo defaults after tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iter4.py covers amp input_map (default + remap + audio_zone/group/scene), SmartThings backend (demo + live-config path + tvvolume + test-connection), display power-on demo timing, and regression suite. Self-host artifacts existence check included. Cleanup done in module-scope teardown fixture.
